source_contract.lock_policy: exact catalogue pixels only; SHA-256 and byte length must match locked copies

target.selection_reason: Unbuilt photo-only exact variant with a coherent front, 60-degree high oblique, and true-top set. The three pixels agree on one U-shaped Dutch brick almshouse court, roof graph, gates, garden, and street pavilion.
target.catalogue_text_conflict: The variant prose says irregular medieval fabric, but the exact locked pixels show a formal, substantially uniform brick hofje. Per RLASM authority order, locked pixels govern this build.

plan_graph.type: asymmetric U around an open south court

open_courtyard.open_to: south street through wall and gates

base_middle_crown.crown: 6.20-9.65 m cornice, gutter, pantile roof and dormers; pavilion gable continues to 12.95 m

pavilion.ground: one arched gate plus one sash bay

roof_graph.ordinary: three connected gable-roof bars terminating at bounded corner hip/valley nodes
junctions: pavilion cross-gable seated into east roof

chimneys.ownership: brick stacks crossing roof body with bounded lead flashing and caps

roof_graph.drainage: continuous courtyard and street eave gutters with downpipes at junctions

elevation_contract.court: warm red-brown stretcher-bond brick, tall vertically proportioned sash openings, restrained pale stone sills/headers, dark green doors, simple pale eave band
elevation_contract.street: same brick/material authority with quieter service cadence and bicycle-scale thresholds
elevation_contract.pavilion: projecting brick volume, tall sash pairs, triangular/curved Dutch gable shoulders, pale cornice bands and two circular stone medallions
elevation_contract.rear: complete occupied brick elevation with sparser service openings; no blank carrier

signature_details: three visibly traversable brick arch gates
continuous clay pantile roof with chimney cadence
courtyard-facing paired green doors and tall sash rhythm
contacts_and_load_paths: all walls bear continuously on brick plinth and grade
pavilion projects through both occupied floors to its own cross-gable roof
dormer cheeks penetrate roof plane and caps seat on complete bodies
chimney stacks penetrate roof and continue visually to occupied wall zones
gate arches spring from full brick piers and expose soffit depth
gutters seat on eaves and downpipes terminate at courtyard drains
garden wall and iron fence bear on continuous brick curb

program.visual_proof: tables, chairs, cabinets, beds, curtains, lamps, stairs, landings and the communal kitchen are modeled at real depth and visible through selected openings and the program-interior camera

identity_strategy.reason_no_mounted_sticker: The exact identity is carried by physical plan, bay schedule, openings, pavilion gable, gates, dormers, roof graph, garden and source-conditioned construction materials. Mounting a full facade crop would duplicate physical windows and contacts.

camera_contract: Every whole-envelope view is derived from actual object bounds after construction and must include the complete visible footprint, grade, highest chimney/gable and neutral margin.
